release.reason: Held until the owner walks the Forest Hill Park line and the Pony Pasture lap against the trail signs (the park map is schematic; Forest Hill uses short OSM connectors such as the steps south of the lake, and Pony Pasture's unnamed paths are matched to the map by eye). The Buttermilk + North Bank half and marathon wait on the checks listed on #1430.

race_courses.name: Forest Hill Park Loop, 5 km
race_courses.start_note: Start and finish on the paved path that runs south from the park drive beside the Stone House. The loop goes round Forest Hill Park: the paved path west of the lake, the Forest Hill Park Trail through the north and east of the park, then the trail south of the lake back to the paved path.

route_guide.getting_there: Park in the Forest Hill Park lot at New Kent Road and 42nd Street (the park map's trailhead lot). Walk east along the park drive to the Stone House. The start line is on the paved path that runs south from the drive beside the Stone House, about 440 m along it.

race_courses.name: Pony Pasture Loop, 5 km
race_courses.start_note: Start and finish on the R.B. Young Riverside Trail east of the Pony Pasture parking lot. Each lap weaves through Pony Pasture: west on the inner woods trails, east along Pleasant Creek, once round The Wetlands (south on the inner wetland trail and back north along the river edge), then back west on the riverside trail and the middle woods trail. It runs a few short stretches twice.

route_guide.getting_there: Park in the Pony Pasture lot on Riverside Drive. The start line is on the gravel riverside trail that leaves the east side of the lot, about 154 m along it.
